description: Return a list of all equipment models

parameters.name: filters[updated_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) last updated within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYY...

id.description: Unique identifier of the equipment model.

managed_equipment_make_id.description: Identifier of the equipment make this model belongs to. Corresponds to a Managed Equipment Make resource.

managed_equipment_type_id.description: Identifier of the equipment type this model belongs to. Corresponds to a Managed Equipment Type resource.

company_id.description: Identifier of the company that owns this equipment model.

is_active.description: Whether this equipment model is currently active and available for use.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this equipment model was last modified, in ISO 8601 format.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this equipment model was created, in ISO 8601 format.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when this equipment model was soft-deleted, in ISO 8601 format. Null if the record is active.

id.description: Unique identifier of the user who created this equipment model.

login.description: Email address of the user who created this equipment model.

name.description: Full name of the user who created this equipment model.

id.description: Unique identifier of the equipment make.

name.description: Name of the equipment make (manufacturer brand).

company_id.description: Identifier of the company that owns this equipment make.

is_active.description: Whether this equipment make is currently active and available for use.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this equipment make was last modified, in ISO 8601 format.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this equipment make was created, in ISO 8601 format.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when this equipment make was soft-deleted, in ISO 8601 format. Null if the record is active.

id.description: Unique identifier of the equipment type.

managed_equipment_category_id.description: Identifier of the equipment category this type belongs to.

company_id.description: Identifier of the company that owns this equipment type.

is_active.description: Whether this equipment type is currently active and available for use.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this equipment type was last modified, in ISO 8601 format.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this equipment type was created, in ISO 8601 format.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when this equipment type was soft-deleted, in ISO 8601 format. Null if the record is active.
